manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the palm-sized bell and put it on the electronicscale with circular platform

Task description: The target is the small bell in the front of the view, with a blue dome and light brown base. Place it on the silver circular weighing platform of the electronic scale at the rear left.

Success criteria: The bell body is near the center of the circular platform, resting on and supported by it; the left gripper is open and has released the bell.

## Execution tips

- Grasp opposite sides of the blue bell's lower half just above the base, with the pads against the wider side surfaces. Avoid grasping only the small top button or pressing the rounded dome where it may slip.
- Set the gripper opening with a little clearance beyond the width of the selected part. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bell body, and check fingertip clearance from the tabletop to avoid missing the grasp or pushing the bell.
- Near the scale platform, bring both the bell base and fingertips past its edge before lowering, avoiding catching the base on the edge or bumping the scale with the gripper.
- Release slowly after the base is supported by the scale platform, and confirm that the pads have cleared the bell before withdrawing, reducing the risk of the bell sliding toward the edge or being carried along by the gripper.
